	ai_potential = { always = no }

xqol_release_hook_recruit_conversion_interaction = {
	hidden = yes
	common_interaction = no
	use_diplomatic_range = no

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			xqol_release_base_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_hook_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_recruit_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_conversion_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:recipient = {
			xqol_release_base_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_hook_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_recruit_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_conversion_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	ai_accept = {
	base = 100
	modifier = {
		add = -20
		scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		desc = RECIPIENT_IS_AMBITIOUS
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -20
		scope:recipient = { ai_zeal <= 20 }
		desc = CONVERSION_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = {
			value = scope:recipient.ai_zeal
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient.faith = {
						faith_hostility_level = {
							target = scope:actor.faith
							value = faith_astray_level
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = -1
			}
			else = { multiply = -2 }
		}
		scope:recipient = { ai_zeal > 20 }
		desc = CONVERSION_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = {
			value = -50
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { ai_vengefulness > 0 } }
				subtract = scope:recipient.ai_vengefulness
			}
		}
		desc = GAIN_HOOK_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -10
		NOT = {
			scope:actor = {
				culture = { has_cultural_parameter = can_recruit_prisoners_easily }
			}
		}
		desc = RECRUITMET_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	}

	on_accept = {
		xqol_release_prisoner_terms_effect = {
			HOOK = yes
			RECRUIT = yes
			CONVERSION = yes
		}
	}

	ai_potential = { always = no }
	ai_frequency = 0
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}
